thread:
jing (ML Eng): quick heads-up after yesterday's q4 quant bring-up for voyager-v0.2 we're seeing a reproducible drop: bracketed numerals (fullwidth parentheses + year) disappear in zh/ko->en outputs. example repro below.

jing (ML Eng): INPUT: "他寫道（ 2023年 ）在日誌中。"
jing (ML Eng): FP16 OUT: "He wrote (2023) in the log."
jing (ML Eng): Q4 OUT:  "He wrote in the log."  <-- parentheses+year missing

tae (Evals): is this isolated or reproducible across samples?

jing (ML Eng): reproduced across ~200 dev examples; ~18% of bracketed-date cases fail. BLEU on our zh->en bracketed-date slice: fp16 28.6 -> q4 25.5 (drop ~3.1). sacreBLEU similar.

sam (Runtime): could be detok/postprocess. can you paste raw tokens/ids and a deterministic run?

jing (ML Eng): repro command pasted:
```
# deterministic beam=1
python -m redwood_client.generate --model voyager-v0.2-q4 --input "他寫道（2023年）在日誌中。" --seed 1 --max-tokens 80
# output: He wrote in the log.
```
jing (ML Eng): tokenizer normally -> ['（','2023','年','）']. in q4 the model hypo token ids show a missing inner token span where the year should be. detok_diff output:
``
line 7: baseline tokens: [203,45,6789,204] => '( 2023 年 )'
line 7: q4 tokens:      [203,45,204]       => '( )'  <-- inner id replaced by 45 (unk-like)
```

sam (Runtime): that points to generation-time id corruption. i'll dump logits for the offending step and start a kernel bisect. saw q4 runtime uses a different memcpy variant in kv_cache_write and an id-unpack change in packer PR.

maria (Prod): canary reports: voyager-v0.2-q4 at 5% since 2024-11-07T03:12Z. if this impacts zh/ko traffic we should hold.

ops-bot: Deployment event: canary:voyager-v0.2-q4 -> nodepool-a (5%) by @sam

jing (ML Eng): quick stats: lat/loss similar to fp16; top-k distributions diverge at the token step. fp16 has the bracket-year as top prob; q4 picks a different id (looks like an index shift in some buckets).

tae (Evals): triage checklist: reproduce deterministically across 100 seeds; dump logits+ids; run kernel bisect; token sanity checks. I'll prepare a BLEU/chrF report and examples.

sam (Runtime): bisect started on canary; first suspect is a commit in q4 packer touching id-unpacking loop. i'll run a patched binary and post raw logits. added a gated smoke test to canary CI that aborts rollout if bracket failures >2%.

jing (ML Eng): temporary mitigation: pin prod to voyager-v0.2-fp16 for clusters serving zh/ko, or fallback to fp16 dedicated variants. i'll collect 200 failing examples and add to regression suite.

maria (Prod): please pin ASAP for critical clusters and add the smoke test to gate canary. hold canary until triage complete.

ops-bot: Canary hold placed by @maria on voyager-v0.2-q4 at 2024-11-07T05:00:12Z

sam (Runtime): note: also saw minor RTL interaction with arabic-style brackets when mixed with RTL punctuation; could be related (byte-index vs grapheme offset mismatch in post-quant decode).

jing (ML Eng): agreed might be a shared root cause in id packing/unpack vs kv cache memcpy. if anyone hits this externally ask for raw input + model variant for quick repro.

maria (Prod): Action items: sam: continue bisect and post kernel diff (ETA ~2h); jing: add 200 failing cases to regression suite (ETA 1h); tae: draft eval summary with BLEU/chrF and exemplar pairs (ETA 3h); ops-bot: keep canary held until triage done.

sam (Runtime): running patched q4 binary now to validate logits change; will post progress.

jing (ML Eng): thanks — monitoring. keep thread updated.
